search_console.decision: The September 7–October 4 report showed 1,214 impressions, two clicks, 0.2% CTR, and average position 35.3. Stem Cell CBG was the only page with a nontrivial position 4–20 signal: 13 impressions, one click, 7.7% CTR, and position 5.3, so its already-relevant URL received one focused evidence and usefulness expansion. Position 4–20 rows with only one to four impressions, a single Oklahoma query click, and the homepage/about samples were deliberately not treated as editorial mandates.

authority.action: Published an NCI-, FDA-, and NCCIH-grounded cancer-claim evidence guide with a printable oncology conversation record; connected it to medication and procedure guides; strengthened the Stem Cell CBG breeder-to-lot evidence chain; expanded storage into transparent fit math; and logged the National Cancer Institute Cancer Information Service as a qualified factual-review/resource opportunity. No outreach was sent.
